description.name: Entry
description.text:
15 single-target Lightning/NE ranged physical attacks, Quick Lightning to party, Lv.3 En-Lightning, En-Lightning Stack, Sync Mode, Cap Break Level 1 & Rock'n roll! to user
Attack (Lightning): 6 single-target Lightning/NE ranged physical attacks
Defend (Lightning): 3 single-target Lightning/NE ranged physical attacks, every 2 uses grant Lightning Damage +10% to user
Rock'n roll!: When an ally uses Lightning abilities, chases with 4 single-target Lightning/NE ranged physical attacks, Lightning Damage +10% for 5 seconds to that ally
